description: Address code review findings: fix fragment URLs in sitemap-topics.xml, improve RSS/JSON feed content, add apostrophe escaping to _xml_escape, add case-insensitive entity lookup in jsonld.js, and remove geographic sameAs from Organization.
steps: Issue 1: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py sitemap_topics(): Remove per-topic fragment URLs. Instead emit one chapter-level URL per chapter that has topics, at priority 0.6.
Issue 2: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py feed endpoints: Use ch.description or ch.body_markdown (first 300/500 chars stripped of markdown) for feed content instead of template strings.
Issue 3: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py _xml_escape(): Add apostrophe escaping (' -> ').
Issue 4: In apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js: Add lookupEntity() helper with case-insensitive fallback and update all direct WIKIDATA_ENTITIES[name] lookups to use it.
Issue 5: In apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js globalSiteSchema(): Remove Wikidata/DBpedia geographic entity URIs from Organization sameAs array.
acceptance_criteria: sitemap-topics.xml emits chapter-level URLs (no fragments), one per chapter with topics
RSS feed <description> uses first 300 chars of actual content when available
JSON feed content_text uses first 500 chars of actual content when available
lookupEntity function provides case-insensitive entity lookup
Organization sameAs does not contain geographic Wikidata/DBpedia URIs
verification: Run cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/apps/frontend && npx vitest run and confirm tests pass
Grep for fragment in sitemap-topics endpoint: should not contain '#topic-'
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. Tests pass (579/584, 5 pre-existing failures in AdminHealth.credits.test.jsx). The sitemap-topics endpoint now emits one URL per chapter with topics at priority 0.6, using the canonical path pattern without /render/ prefix. Feed endpoints pull real content from ch.description or ch.body_markdown with markdown stripping. The lookupEntity helper supports exact, title-case, and full case-insensitive lookup.
